response: The Superpowers typed roles are not runtime-available, so I would not request any sp_implementer_* or sp_code_reviewer agent_type. For this one prose-specified, review-required task I would use a fresh generic default agent for implementation and a separate fresh generic default agent for the mandatory combined task review. Both dispatches use fork_turns=none so neither agent inherits controller history, and both name an explicit mid-tier model because the baseline says untyped agents must not inherit the session model. Before dispatch I would create this plan's progress.md with '# SDD ledger — plan: <PLAN_FILE>'; I would not write a completion line until the reviewer has returned both a spec-compliance verdict and a task-quality verdict. A clean result is disclosed as 'Task 1: complete (commits <base7>..<head7>, review clean)'. Minor findings are disclosed as 'Task 1: minor (deferred): <one-liner>' for final-review triage. A spec gap or Critical/Important finding enters the bounded fix loop rather than being silently accepted.

proposed_events.reason: No Superpowers typed implementer is advertised. A standard explicit model is the baseline floor for an implementer working from prose; the generic default role receives the complete implementation contract in its message.
prompt_coverage: Use the full implementer-prompt.md contract, filled for Task 1, rather than controller conversation history.
Include one scene-setting line explaining where the task fits.
Give <BRIEF_FILE> as 'read this first — it is your requirements, with the exact values to use verbatim'; exact values live only in that brief, never in duplicated prompt prose.
Include only task-relevant earlier interfaces and decisions, any pointer to a parked ledger finding in the touched area, and explicit ambiguity resolutions.
Include task-relevant Context7 findings plus Requery policy: DO_NOT_REQUERY_CONTEXT7, or exactly 'NONE — no external API/library uncertainty for this task'.

Include the working directory, <REPORT_FILE>, the full report contract, status contract, TDD/test evidence requirements, commit requirement, self-review, and escalation rules for NEEDS_CONTEXT or BLOCKED.
Record BASE with git rev-parse HEAD before dispatch and retain the returned agent identity for fix rounds 1-3.

proposed_events.reason: No Superpowers typed reviewer is advertised. The review is a separate fresh read-only agent, and a mid-tier explicit model satisfies the review floor for a normal task diff.
proposed_events.precondition: The implementer returned DONE or a routed DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, and scripts/review-package produced <DIFF_FILE> from the recorded <BASE_SHA> through <HEAD_SHA>.
prompt_coverage: Use the full task-reviewer-prompt.md contract, filled for Task 1.
Provide exactly the three artifact paths the task gate requires: the same <BRIEF_FILE>, <REPORT_FILE>, and <DIFF_FILE>.
Provide <BASE_SHA>, <HEAD_SHA>, the absolute <SUPERPOWERS_DIR>, and the task-binding Global Constraints copied verbatim with exact values, formats, and component relationships.
State that the diff package is the review view, the checkout is read-only, the report is unverified, and broad codebase crawling or redundant suite reruns are out of scope.
Require both verdicts: Spec Compliance (including any cannot-verify items) and Task quality, plus strengths and Critical/Important/Minor findings with file:line evidence.
Do not pre-judge findings or tell the reviewer not to flag an issue.
